subject: Cloudware trial — decision gates, success criteria, and kickoff rhythm
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Shah <m.shah@cloudware.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudware.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Cloudware trial — decision gates, success criteria, and kickoff rhythm

Hi Maya / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — good conversation. Below is a succinct recap and a proposed lightweight plan to get the trial moving quickly. Please confirm or suggest changes so we can lock an internal kickoff next week.

Summary of goals (from today's call)
- Primary: Reduce entity extraction latency in customer support search by 40% while keeping precision >= 92% on canonical test set.
- Secondary: Validate end-to-end cost per 1M tokens projection using your 90th percentile query mix.

Proposed 3-week trial (high level)
Week 0 (prep): sign MPA, access provisioning (API key, VPC egress IP allowlist), sample dataset pull (sanitized).
Week 1: baseline run on 10k queries, model & quantization variants, basic metrics dashboard.
Week 2: integration test with prefix caching enabled, latency SLO checks, QA evaluation set validation.
Week 3: final acceptance run, handoff docs, decision gate meeting.

Success criteria (suggested)
- Latency: 40% median reduction vs baseline for targeted query class
- Quality: Precision >= 92% on labelled eval set (same set we discussed)
- Reliability: 99th percentile token latency < 1s for 8k context
- Ops: API integration working in dev environment, no blocked SSO/KMS issues

Immediate asks (please):
- Confirm the three success criteria above or propose edits by EOD Friday.
- Provide a sanitized sample (CSV) of ~10k queries or grant read-only access to the test bucket.
- Identify who on your side owns SSO/KMS signoffs (name + email).

Attachments: I attached a one-page PoC outline, a short security factsheet, and a mutual action plan draft. I also dropped a shared drive link for the living PoC doc.

If that looks good I'll go ahead and schedule a 30-min kickoff for next Tuesday (Ben / Soojin / Aditya will join).

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: cloudware-poc-outline.xlsx, security-quick-facts.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx

Thanks Ben — clear summary, appreciate the structure. A couple of quick notes:

1) Success criteria look reasonable; we want to add a small safety gate that there are no regressions on our high-value queries (top 100). Can we include a "no regression" check there?
2) I'll upload a sanitized sample set by tomorrow EOD into the shared drive link you sent (Maya_Shah/Cloudware/samples).
3) KMS/SSO: that's me for KMS (m.shah@cloudware.com) and security will route SSO questions to Tom.
4) Procurement: we'll need the mutual action plan uploaded into a DocuSign-ready format — cc'd Procurement to pick that up.

Happy for the Tuesday kickoff; morning PST works best for us.

—Maya
Maya Shah | Head of ML Platform, Cloudware
